name: Rivet
description: Desktop application for designing AI agents and prompt chains as graphs that can then be embedded in your own application.
whatItDoes: Teams build and debug complex agent logic visually, then run the same graphs from their product. It supports OpenAI and Anthropic models, AssemblyAI for voice data and vector database integrations.
howItWorks: Graphs of nodes are edited and executed in the desktop app. Build-from-source steps live in the contributing guide rather than the README, so no commands are listed here.
